div.head: Rect 11
div.ab: [11] Be sædere. Sædere gebyreð, þæt he hæbbe ælces sædcynnes ænne leap fulne, ðonne he ælc sæd wel gesawen hæbbe ofer geares fyrst.
Sædere (id est seminatori) pertinet, ut habeat unoquoque sementis tempore I leap fulne, quando semen omne bene seminauerit in anni spatio.
Be SæDERE . Sædere gebyreð þæt he hæbbe ælces sædcyn|nes ænne leap fulne · ðonne he ælc sæd wel gesawen hæbbe ofer geares fyrst.
Be sædere Sædere gebyreð þæt he hæbbe ælces sædcynnes ænne leap fulne ðonne he ælc sæd wel gesawen hæbbe ofer geares fyrst.
Vom Säemann. Dem Säemann gebührt, dass er von jeder Saatgattung 1 ‘Korb’ [c. ½ (⅔) Bushel = c. 18 (24) Liter] voll erhalte, wenn er jede Saat gut gesät hat über den [ganzen] Jahreslauf.
Of the sower. To the sower is due that he receive 1 ‘basket’ [c. ½ (⅔) bushel] full of each kind of seed, when he has sown each seed well throughout the [whole] year.
Concerning the sower For the sower it is fitting that he have one bucket full of each kind of seed, when he has sown each seed well throughout the year.
Regarding the Sower For the sower, it is appropriate that he have one full bucket of each variety of seed after he has sown all his seed satisfactorily over the course of the year.
div.note: The Quadripartitus perhaps read ‘tima’ for ‘cyn’. K: a typo ‘þat’ corrected.
